summary: H7 blind first-time run. Spawned on Throop Ave, could not find the HOME sign or house in about 20 steps of searching along Throop, Kosciusko and the sidewalks, so the home, turntables and DJ decks were never reached. Harness N key is ignored, so the HOME/WAX DELI pointer cycle could not be used. Walked into the Crate Digger ring by accident (mission started on contact). Inside WAX DELI: buying works through the bins panel with ArrowDown/Enter, Escape closes it. Enter on an owned row in the Your crate tab sold Stoop Season for 6 dollars with no confirmation. Ms. Odette's mission had a cryptic 'go be seen first' line and a 'Head back outside inside' goal. Mission paid out on leaving the shop. Drove a sedan one block and got out fine. Phone opens on the last tab, E works and Q is ignored by the harness. Late text from Odette arrived after the mission was done. Radio caption overlapped the Exit car prompt.
